_d162_model.domain_caveat: the committed fit is n=33,401 rows with predicted_p50 0.2519 against actual_p50 0.2455 (ratio 1.0261). The robot recalls diagnosed here sit in the multi-thousand-uncached TAIL of that fit, where the POSITIVE CONTROL below shows it UNDER-predicts the observed first token by 1.39x to 1.87x. Every warm conversion is therefore also reported with the worst observed under-prediction applied as a stress.
_d162_model.proxy_declared_uncached_queued_ahead: PROXY. The committed model's queue term is the engine's own queued uncached work (coordinator.py:1293 feeds `queued_uncached_ahead=self._w.total()` to the D179 (4) re-check). That running total is not in the committed per-cell logs, so this diagnosis reconstructs it from request.jsonl.gz as the sum of (prompt_tokens - cached_tokens) over requests submitted at or before the decision instant whose t_first_token had not yet arrived. VALID for the claim: it is built from ENGINE-REPORTED token counts and real submit/first-token stamps, and the quantity it estimates is monotone in it. It is NOT the coordinator's own counter and may differ from it; it is used only inside the counterfactual, never as a headline measurement.
_d162_model.proxy_declared_warm_uncached: CONSTRUCTED. 'History already warm' is fed as 80 uncached tokens, from the only two ENGINE-REPORTED robo001 sends in the seed-5 cell, where prompt_tokens minus trace history_tokens was 82 (r2551: 15,143 - 15,061) and 75 (r5831: 20,356 - 20,281). This is the IDEAL keep-ready case: the entire history resident, so only the question text is uncached. It is an upper bound on what keep-ready can buy, which is the right direction for a counterfactual that is used to decide whether keep-ready is worth building.

_physical_plausibility.fastest_first_token_claimed: the smallest predicted warm first token in the counterfactual is 0.139 s at 80 uncached tokens and 368 queued-ahead tokens
_physical_plausibility.implied_rate: that is not a measured rate; it is the D162 intercept (0.0678 s) plus two linear terms. The implied per-token prefill rate of the uncached term alone is 1/0.000182 = 5,488 tok/s, which is BELOW the committed A6000 cold prefill of about 7,100 tok/s (reports/phase1_cost_profiling.md) and therefore not a faster-than-measured artefact.
_physical_plausibility.cold_rebuild_rates_used: costs.COLD_PREFILL_TOK_S = 4,500 tok/s at 11k and 3,800 tok/s at 28k, both below the committed 7,100 tok/s A6000 cold prefill, so no quoted cold estimate implies a rate faster than the committed curve.

_distribution_sanity.artefact_spread_check: the seed-7 spread is real and it CANNOT carry the meaning 'keep-ready would help', because every one of those 18 values is above the 32,768 context limit. The spread says only how far above.

effect_not_averaged_out.stratum: the convertible misses are concentrated entirely on ONE device-session, robo001|s001 at seed 5, during the 87 s window t=791.8 to t=878.4
effect_not_averaged_out.mixing_weight: 4 convertible misses out of 13 recall-pool misses at seed 5 (30.8 percent of that seed's misses) and 0 out of 21 at seed 7, so 4 of 34 misses (11.8 percent) across the two seeds. A two-seed mean of 11.8 percent would read as 'warming barely matters' and would be wrong about seed 5 and wrong about seed 7 in opposite directions.

_claim_linkage.bears_on: the Context Inertia physical component (FORMULATION.md: transfer and reconstruction latency grows with context length) and on the keep-ready / state axis of the representation x placement x timing claim.
_claim_linkage.supports: that reconstruction latency is the binding term for the seed-5 laggard: the arm's own feasibility estimate was 6.19 to 6.36 s of COLD rebuild against a 3.0 s deadline, and the engine charged 14,516 uncached tokens on the one send it did make.
_claim_linkage.does_not_speak_to: the semantic component. Nothing here measures fidelity or accuracy; the currency is on-time cloud delivery only (D177).
_claim_linkage.scoped_out_check: nothing measured here is KV transfer between heterogeneous tiers (FORMULATION.md section Scoping, KV portability). All residency here is within one engine's own prefix cache.

bucket_counts_OBSERVED_CENSUS._denominator: 23 missed questions: 5 of robo001's 6 at seed 5 and 18 of robo004's 21 at seed 7, both taken from cell.json score.sweep[0].robot_per_device, which the committed verdict reproduces exactly.

warm_counterfactual_split._the_finding: 4 of 23 misses (17.4 percent) would have been converted by a history that was already resident, and ZERO of the 23 would have missed because of queued work ahead. The queue is not what dooms these devices. 18 of 23 (78.3 percent) are above the engine's 32,768-token context limit and keep-ready cannot touch them at any residency; 1 of 23 is the run horizon.

1_the_eviction_that_cost_seed_5.trace_OBSERVED: robo001|s001 residency.jsonl: cold at t=388.23, gpu from t=434.76 with telemetry_cached_tokens climbing 992 -> 7,376 by t=756.54, then COLD with telemetry 0 at t=843.49, then gpu again at t=925.21 with telemetry 21,232.
1_the_eviction_that_cost_seed_5.ready_too_late_definition: 925.207 minus 878.36: the history read fully resident 46.85 s AFTER the last question that needed it. OBSERVED.
1_the_eviction_that_cost_seed_5.what_a_keep_ready_policy_must_change: hold the session resident across the gap instead of letting it fall out and be re-prefilled. The re-prefill actually happened at t=837.79, where the touch request r6067 reports prompt_tokens 21,251 with cached_tokens 0 and cache_path COLD (ENGINE-REPORTED), so the 21k tokens were paid for anyway, 27 s before the first decline, and the three declines were taken on a belief that had already been overtaken.

2_the_maintenance_channel_is_rate_limite.touch_cadence_OBSERVED: one touch per 46.00 s (nine consecutive gaps of 45.99 to 46.01 s on robo001|s001 at seed 5), each adding 990 prompt tokens and 11 mm_uuids.
2_the_maintenance_channel_is_rate_limite.robot_history_growth_rate_CONSTRUCTED: 44.9 tokens per second, from the trace's own history_tokens on robo004|s000 at seed 7: (52,861 - 34,051) / (916.67 - 499.25)
2_the_maintenance_channel_is_rate_limite.consequence: the built prefix never catches the history. robo004|s000 reached 52,861 trace history tokens while the last touch had built 14,861 (28.1 percent); robo001|s001 reached 20,281 while the last touch before the send had built 8,921 (44.0 percent). A keep-ready policy that only keeps the EXISTING prefix hot does not fix this; it has to raise the build rate (bigger or more frequent touches) or stop promising full-history answers.

3_the_feasibility_test_reads_a_tier_wher.reader_file_line: experiments/orchestration/live2/hybrid/hybrid_arm.py:401, `est = float(C.recall_ttft_s(max(q.readiness_tokens, 1), q.readiness))`, consumed by the CLOUD/DEFER/REJECT branch at hybrid_arm.py:421-426. This is a read that changes a decision, not a write-only field.
3_the_feasibility_test_reads_a_tier_wher.writer_file_line: experiments/orchestration/live2/cstate.py:138 `residency_readiness()`, which returns one of three TIER LABELS from cstate.py:135 `believed_tier()`, the argmax of a three-way belief.
3_the_feasibility_test_reads_a_tier_wher.the_defect: the estimate prices the FULL readiness_tokens at the tier's warm rate. On opp0008040 that is recall_ttft_s(20,281, 'GPU-WARM') = 0.6506 s. The engine then charged 14,516 uncached tokens and the observed first token was 5.3166 s, 8.17x the arm's own estimate. GPU-WARM means 'the last completed request found a prefix', not 'this whole history is resident'.
3_the_feasibility_test_reads_a_tier_wher.the_quantity_already_exists_and_does_not: hybrid_arm.py:526-534 `_unbuilt_rebuild_s` already reads `roster['built_tokens_by_session']` and prices the UNBUILT remainder as a cold prefill. Its only consumer is the C2 RISK FLAG at hybrid_arm.py:404-409 (`work = est + self._unbuilt_rebuild_s(q); laxity = qs - work; risk = ...`). It is NOT in the feasibility branch. On opp0008040 it would have returned (20,281 - 8,921) / 3,800 = 2.99 s CONSTRUCTED, giving work = 0.6506 + 2.989 = 3.640 s against 2.8995 s of slack (deadline_abs 794.6595 minus now 791.76), i.e. the arm held a quantity that predicted the miss and used it only to throttle dashcam frames.
3_the_feasibility_test_reads_a_tier_wher.what_a_keep_ready_policy_would_have_to_c: 1) gate the recall send on `est + _unbuilt_rebuild_s(q)` rather than on `est` alone, so a partially resident history is not sent as though it were warm; 2) make the keep-ready decision on RESIDENT TOKENS, not on a tier label, since the tier was GPU-WARM at 44 percent resident and at 28 percent resident alike; 3) treat a telemetry report of cached_tokens 0 as evidence about the instant it was taken, not about the future, because at t=865 the session was being re-prefilled by the coordinator's own touch while the arm declined three questions on a COLD belief.

keep_ready_implications.4_what_keep_ready_cannot_fix: 78.3 percent of these misses are over the 32,768-token limit and 4.3 percent are the run horizon. For the over-limit stratum the only levers are a shorter REPRESENTATION (simplestream released all 18 at 467 tokens, per d170_overlimit.json) or a larger max-model-len. D170 ruled the harness must COUNT and not truncate, so this is a POLICY axis, not a harness fix. A keep-ready counterfactual run that scored itself on seed 7 robot on-time would be measuring almost nothing: its headroom there is 0 of 21 misses.
keep_ready_implications.5_where_the_next_counterfactual_should_b: on seed 5, and on the per-device minimum rather than the pool fraction. The pool fraction at seed 5 is 114 of 127 = 0.8976 and already passes check 2 at a retention of 0.9886; the whole lag is 5 questions on one device, which the pool number cannot see. At seed 7 the per-device floor is 0.1429 on robo004 and is immovable by residency.

rule_2_classification._is_this_a_null: No. This is a diagnosis of an observed shortfall, not a policy comparison, so Rule 2 does not classify it. It is recorded here because the NEXT step does need it.
rule_2_classification.pre_registered_warning_for_the_keep_read: if a keep-ready arm is scored on seed 7 robot on-time it will produce a NULL, and that null would be Rule 2 INCONCLUSIVE - UNEXERCISED, not a real negative: 18 of the 21 misses there are above the context limit, so the mechanism has no reachable path on that stratum. Scoring it on seed 5 reaches at most 4 convertible questions on one device, which is also the ceiling that a power calculation has to start from. Both figures are on the page BEFORE the run.

alternative_explanations.alternative: the seed-5 declines are not an eviction at all but the arm's defer_s being too short, so the three re-asks were refused by arithmetic that warming would not change
alternative_explanations.what_distinguishes_it: the BELIEF tier and the ENGINE telemetry both read COLD / 0 at all three declines while the same session read gpu / 7,376 seventy-three seconds earlier and gpu / 21,232 forty-seven seconds later. The input to the arithmetic changed, not the arithmetic. If defer_s were the cause the belief would have stayed gpu.

alternative_explanations.alternative: robo004's seed-7 lag is a queue or fairness-ordering effect, with the over-limit declines incidental
alternative_explanations.what_distinguishes_it: the fairness feed gave robo004 the LARGEST recall weight in the cell (w_d = 2.68254, against 1.0 for the four devices at or above 0.9), so the ordering consumer was pushing it to the FRONT, and it still missed 18. The 18 declines are one-to-one with the 18 trace-determined over-limit opportunity ids and with arm_stats.over_limit_infeasible = 18. No ordering can serve a prompt the engine refuses.

alternative_explanations.alternative: the warm conversions are an artefact of the D162 model being optimistic in the tail
alternative_explanations.what_distinguishes_it: the model's worst observed under-prediction on the sent rows of these very devices (1.4286x at seed 5, 1.8721x at seed 7) is applied as a stress and all four conversions survive it, the tightest at 2.057 s against a 2.889 s budget. The conversions also survive the completion-basis budget. They do NOT survive an arbitrary 3x, which is stated rather than hidden.
alternative_explanations.distinguished: partially; the stress is bounded by the observed factors, not proved beyond them
